## Core AI Tool Verticals & Taxonomies

- [Coding Agents](https://listaiassets.com/categories/coding): Autonomous IDEs, multi-file refactoring, terminal agents, and predictive code completion. Leading tools: Cursor AI, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, DeepSeek-R1, GitHub Copilot, v0 by Vercel.
- [LLMs & Reasoning](https://listaiassets.com/categories/llms): Hybrid reasoning models with extended chain-of-thought tokens, 200k+ context windows, and tool execution. Leading tools: Claude 3.7 Sonnet, DeepSeek-R1, ChatGPT 4o.
- [Generative Art](https://listaiassets.com/categories/art): High-fidelity image synthesis, raster diffusion, and rectified flow models. Leading tools: Midjourney v7, Flux.1 Schnell, Recraft AI.
- [Video & Animation](https://listaiassets.com/categories/video): Cinematic text-to-video, camera control, and physical simulation engines. Leading tools: Runway Gen-3 Alpha, Kling AI.
- [Research & Deep Search](https://listaiassets.com/categories/search): Grounded conversational research with real-time citations and academic synthesis. Leading tools: Perplexity Pro, NotebookLM.
- [Voice & Speech](https://listaiassets.com/categories/audio): Zero-latency speech-to-speech APIs, voice cloning, and emotional narration. Leading tools: ElevenLabs Prime, Whisper Large v3.
- [Productivity & Assistants](https://listaiassets.com/categories/productivity): Workspace intelligence, meeting synthesis, and inbox automation. Leading tools: Notion AI, Julius AI.
- [Customer Support & Chatbots](https://listaiassets.com/categories/support): Autonomous ticket resolution agents and omnichannel knowledge base deflection. Leading tools: Fin by Intercom.
- [Workflow Automation](https://listaiassets.com/categories/workflow): Visual orchestration engines chaining LLMs with webhook APIs. Leading tools: Make AI.
- [Legal & Compliance](https://listaiassets.com/categories/legal): Contract redlining, regulatory analysis, and audit trails. Leading tools: Harvey AI.

## Benchmark Methodology
ListAIAssets evaluates every model and software tool across a 14-parameter empirical test suite:
- Latency (ms): Time-to-first-token (TTFT) and end-to-end execution latency.
- Throughput (tokens/sec): Sustained generation speed across peak load hours.
- Code Accuracy (%): Standardized HumanEval and SWE-bench verified completion scores.
- Commercial Licensing: Verification of open-weights (Apache 2.0 / MIT) vs proprietary API terms.
- Pricing Transparency: Normalized per-month starting tiers and cost-per-credit telemetry.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- What is ListAIAssets?: An enterprise-grade AI directory and telemetry matrix indexing over 10,000 tools across 18 specialized verticals on listaiassets.com.
- How do tools rank?: Rankings are derived strictly from empirical latency, code accuracy, and verified developer community reviews. Sponsored placements are explicitly badged and cannot alter benchmark positions.
